official indicator definition title: Foreign direct investment, net inflows (% of GDP)
indicator limitation: Volatile financial flows and conduit economies
Ceiling effect and no quality measurement
Neither high inflation nor deflation is unconditionally desirable
Perception index check vintage and uncertainty

official indicator definition title: General government final consumption expenditure (% of GDP)
indicator limitation: NOT a measure of industrial policy or state ownership
Strongly affected by size geography and entrepot trade
National output is not household disposable income

official indicator definition title: Educational attainment, at least completed upper secondary, population 25+, total (%) (cumulative)
indicator limitation: Sparse survey coverage and qualifications differ

official indicator definition title: Poverty headcount ratio at $3.00 a day (2021 PPP) (% of population)
indicator limitation: PPP poverty threshold must be read from saved source metadata
Income versus consumption and survey comparability require review
Overlaps GDP per capita use as sensitivity

official indicator definition title: Ratio of female to male labor force participation rate (%) (modeled ILO estimate)
indicator limitation: Not a complete gender equality measure and values above parity complicate direction

official indicator definition title: Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (modeled ILO estimate)
indicator limitation: Modeled ILO estimate definitions and informal employment matter
Modeled estimates and correlated health outcomes
Contemporary population not historical boundary harmonization

official indicator definition title: Tariff rate, applied, weighted mean, all products (%)
indicator limitation: Import weights endogenous and non tariff barriers excluded
